gear_lollipop.desc: Nimble and fast, but slides in turns. A solid step up between its world's starter and premium parts.

gear_licorice.name: Licorice Tracks
gear_licorice.brief: compact tracks made of braided licorice ropes
gear_licorice.desc: Compact tracks: spin on the spot, very agile. A solid step up between its world's starter and premium parts.

gear_bubblehover.name: Bubble Hover
gear_bubblehover.brief: hover pods inside glossy soap bubbles with shell frames
gear_bubblehover.desc: Hover pods: fast and spin on the spot, but little grip. A solid step up between its world's starter and premium parts.

gear_yoyo.name: Yo-yo Wheels
gear_yoyo.brief: giant yo-yo wheels with string-wound hubs
gear_yoyo.desc: Orbit rings: fast, agile and grippy. A solid step up between its world's starter and premium parts.

gear_ratchet.name: Ratchet Treads
gear_ratchet.brief: brass tracks with ratchet-tooth cleats and copper guards
gear_ratchet.desc: Grippy tracks that turn on the spot and push harder. A solid step up between its world's starter and premium parts.

gear_pendulum.name: Pendulum Skis
gear_pendulum.brief: brass skis hanging from pendulum struts
gear_pendulum.desc: Ski runners: the fastest glide, very slippery. A solid step up between its world's starter and premium parts.

gear_nimbus.name: Nimbus Treads
gear_nimbus.brief: wide fluffy cloud tracks with golden road wheels
gear_nimbus.desc: Wide flotation tracks: the strongest push, slower but rock-steady. A solid step up between its world's starter and premium parts.
